steps.content: She sends you back, to where the stele is. It stands silent and solemn, just as it did the last time you were here, but now you understand the words engraved on the stele.
The stele is a monument to the 42 individuals who lost their lives while venturing into the unknown to learn about the source of the catastrophes.
Their bodies, their clothes, and their souls have been reduced to nothingness. All that is left is their names.
And the only name that's shining, you recognize it too.
<color=#fb9259>Dreya</color>, that's the name of the astronomer who was a member of the Expedition.
What you saw are her memories before she departed from the mortal world. You saw how she gave herself up to the Illusory Moon.
She's gone, but she's left her name behind, to guide you out of this illusory realm.
You're free to go now, but...
You look up at the sky. The Illusory Moon is contorted, getting more menacing by the second. A shadow figure is taking form, and it is roaring.
You know that the stubborn scholar has lost the chance to leave. She'll be trapped here forever...
